headline: Insurance Boss Who Falsifies Financial Reports Could Face Sanctions, Here's the Rule
summary: OJK is tightening supervision of insurance and pension fund industries, banning manipulation of financial reports. Violators could face sanctions.
why: Stricter reporting oversight improves transparency at insurers and pension funds, which are major institutional investors in local markets.
original_headline: Bos Asuransi Poles Laporan Keuangan Bisa Kena Sanksi, Ini Aturannya
